groups.context: Rafael and Charlotte consider a new village trading post, with separate story transactions in later ports. Resolve each setting from its complete exchange.

records.Japanese: …はい、これが今回の分よ
records.current_English:
...Here you are. 
 This is the latest batch.

records.Japanese:
ありがとう
ところで…ねえ、シャルロット
records.current_English: Thank you. By the way, Charlotte...

records.Japanese: なあに？
records.current_English: What?

records.Japanese:
やっぱり、商売をするなら
ちゃんとした交易所を建てたほうが
いいと思うんだ
records.current_English:
I've been thinking. If you're going
 to trade, you should build a proper
 trade house.

records.Japanese: 交易所？
records.current_English: A trade house?

records.Japanese:
もっと多くの品目を扱って
専門に売買できるようにするんだ
records.current_English:
You could handle more kinds
 of goods and have a place just 
 for buying and selling.

records.Japanese:
そうすれば、交易のために
遠回りしてでもここに訪れる船が
出てくるよ
records.current_English: Ships would detour to trade here.

records.Japanese:
でも…、ちゃんとした交易所なら
そこで働く人も必要でしょ
村の人たちは、今の仕事で手一杯よ
records.current_English:
But... a proper trade house
 would need people
 to work there, 
 wouldn't it? 
 Everyone in the village already
 has their hands full.

records.Japanese:
人を雇えばいいのさ
交易所ができれば船が来るし
この街で働こうって人も
やって来るよ
records.current_English:
You could hire people. 
 A trade house would bring ships
 here, and people looking for work
 would come too.

records.Japanese:
どうやって、その人たちの
賃金を払うの？
records.current_English: How would we pay their wages?

records.Japanese:
交易所で商人に商業投資を募るのさ
最初にお金が入ってくれば
あとは交易の利益でやっていける
records.current_English:
You could ask merchants to invest
 in trade at the trade house. 
 Once you had the money 
 to get started,
 the profits from trading 
 would keep it going.

records.Japanese:
そんなにうまく行くかしら？
この村には、商人たちがわざわざ
交易所で取引するほどの
特産品がないわ
records.current_English:
Would that work? We have nothing 
 special worth merchants' attention.

records.Japanese:
投資で村が発展すれば、もっと
たくさんの特産品を作れるように
なるんだ。新しい特産品だって
できる！
records.current_English:
Investment would help the village
 grow. You could produce more local 
 goods, and even develop new ones!

records.Japanese:
…投資してくれる人なんて
いるのかしら？
records.current_English: Would anyone really invest here?

records.Japanese: もちろん！　僕がするよ！
records.current_English: Of course! Count on me!

records.Japanese:
…
やっぱり無理よ
records.current_English: No... won't work.

records.Japanese: どうして？
records.current_English: Why not?

records.Japanese:
この辺には、建築用の石材や木材が
ほとんどないの。大きな
交易所なんて建てられないわ
records.current_English:
There's hardly any building stone
 or timber around here. We couldn't 
 build a big trade house.

records.Japanese:
そんなの、運んでくればいいんだよ！
僕が木材を用意するから
心配しないで待ってて！
records.current_English:
Then we can bring it in! I'll get
 the timber. Don't worry. Just
 wait for me!

groups.context: Rafael and Charlotte consider a new village trading post, with separate story transactions in later ports. Resolve each setting from its complete exchange.

records.Japanese: FI…！

やあ、シャルロット！
木材を仕入れてきたよ！
これで、交易所を建てよう！
records.current_English:
Hi, Charlotte! I've brought
 the timber! Let's build
 that trade house!

records.Japanese:
すごい…！
でも…、こんなにたくさんの木材を
買えるだけのお金は村にないわ
records.current_English:
Amazing! But the village cannot
 afford this much timber.

records.Japanese: お金なんていらないよ
records.current_English: You don't have to pay me.

records.Japanese: そんな！
records.current_English: But...!

records.Japanese:
これも投資のうちなんだ
この村で特産品がたくさん買える
ようになったら
僕が真っ先に買いに来るからね！
records.current_English:
It's part of my investment. Once 
 you've got plenty of local goods 
 to sell, I'll be the first to come 
 and buy them!

records.Japanese:
ありがとう、FI！
…時間はかかると思うけど、がんばって
きっと立派な交易所にするわね！
records.current_English:
Thank you, FI! It may take some
 time, but I'll work hard to make 
 it a fine trade house!

records.Japanese: 待ってるよ！
records.current_English: Can't wait!

records.Japanese:
さあ、忙しくなるわ！
がんばらなくちゃ！
records.current_English: Now we'll be busy! Time to work!

groups.context: Rafael and Charlotte consider a new village trading post, with separate story transactions in later ports. Resolve each setting from its complete exchange.

records.Japanese:
交易品を安く買って高く売る
これが交易の基本じゃ
records.current_English:
Buy low, sell high. That is how
 trade works.

records.Japanese:
地中海とアフリカを往復できるように
なれば、手っ取り早く儲けることが
できるぞい
records.current_English:
Once you can sail between
 the Mediterranean and Africa,
 you can turn a quick profit.

records.Japanese:
まあ、いきなり遠出はムリじゃろう
から、近場で様子を見るのじゃ
records.current_English:
Stay close to home for now.
 A long voyage is too much.

records.Japanese:
各街の相場を見て
大儲けを狙ってみてもよいぞ
records.current_English:
Check the market prices in each
 town and look for a chance to make 
 a good profit.

records.Japanese:
ここ、リスボンでは
サフランかアーモンドを買っておいて
セウタあたりへ売りに行くのが
よいじゃろう
records.current_English:
Here in Lisbon, try buying saffron 
 or almonds and selling them
 in Ceuta.

records.Japanese:
最初のうちは、船の数も
積むことのできる船倉も少ないのでな
一度に売り買いできる品数は多くない
records.current_English:
At first, few ships and cargo holds
 limit how much you can trade.

records.Japanese:
ひとつの積荷倉庫一杯に積む事のできる
量が売買の一単位じゃ。積荷倉庫の数に
応じて買えるというわけじゃな
records.current_English:
One unit of goods fills one cargo
 hold. The number of holds
 determines how much you can buy.

records.Japanese:
また、『シェア』によっても一度に
扱える数が変わる。無論、『シェア』が
高いほど、たくさん取引できるように
なるぞい
records.current_English:
Market share also affects how much 
 you can trade at once. The greater 
 your share, the more you can trade.

records.Japanese: シェア？
records.current_English: Market share?

records.Japanese: なるほど
records.current_English: Got it.

records.Japanese:
シェアって…
どうやって増やすんですか？
records.current_English: How do we increase our market share?

records.Japanese:
シェアに空きがあるならば
王宮や交易所で投資をした者に分けて
くれる
records.current_English:
If any market share is unclaimed,
 you can gain some by investing 
 at the palace or trade house.

records.Japanese:
まあ、最初のうちは気にせんでも
よいぞ。ある程度稼いで、船が増えて
からの話じゃからの。とにかく、まずは
交易を試してみることじゃ
records.current_English:
Don't worry about that just yet. 
 It matters once you've made some 
 money and have more ships. First,
 give trading a try.

records.Japanese:
全部よければ、『決定』で
取引終了じゃ
さあ、やってみるのじゃ
records.current_English:
When everything looks right, 
 choose Finish to complete the deal.
 Now, give it a try.

groups.context: Rafael and Charlotte consider a new village trading post, with separate story transactions in later ports. Resolve each setting from its complete exchange.

records.Japanese: シナモンをいつもの量で、頼むよ
records.current_English: My usual order of cinnamon, please.

records.Japanese: （先客かな？）
records.current_English: (Someone beat us here?)

records.Japanese: はいよ、お代はこれだけだ
records.current_English: Sure thing. Here's the total.

records.Japanese: おや、値上がりしたんだね
records.current_English: Oh? Price went up?

records.Japanese:
そんなことないよ
いつもこんなもんじゃないか
records.current_English: No. Same as always.

records.Japanese:
ははは、アディール。バカ言っちゃ
いけない。あんたがいくらで仕入れて
いるか、わたしが知らないとでも
思っているのかい？
records.current_English:
Ha ha, come on, Adil. You think
 I don't know what you paid for it?

records.Japanese: おいおい
records.current_English: Hey...

records.Japanese:
今年の出来高とこのへんの需要を
考えれば、もう少し何とかできると
思うんだけどねえ
records.current_English:
With this year's harvest 
 and the demand around here, I think
 you could do a little better.

records.Japanese:
なんなら、他をあたってもいいさ
いつも同じ店から仕入れなきゃ
ならないって法もないし
records.current_English:
I can always try another shop. 
 No law says I have to buy
 from the same place every time.

records.Japanese:
うっ
…わ、分かったよ
もう、あんたにはかなわねえな
records.current_English:
Ugh... A-all right.
 I can't win with you.

records.Japanese:
ん？
…アディール、熱でもあるのかい？
records.current_English: Hm? Adil, do you have a fever?

records.Japanese:
何だよ、カルロ。まだ俺の商売に
難クセつけようってのかい？
records.current_English:
What now, Carlo? Something else
 wrong with how I run my shop?

records.Japanese:
そうじゃない。おまえさん
熱があるよ。今日は早く寝るんだね
records.current_English:
That's not it. You've got a fever. 
 You should turn in early tonight.

records.Japanese:
またまた、何を……
あれ？　何だか本当に寒気がする
records.current_English:
Oh, come on... Wait. 
 I really do feel a chill.

records.Japanese:
ほらごらん。買い物は明日にするから
今日は店じまいだ
records.current_English:
See? I'll do my buying tomorrow. 
 Close up for today.

records.Japanese:
うーん…、あんたの言うとおりに
しよう。そこの人も
悪いけど明日にしておくれ
records.current_English:
Hmm... I'll do as you say. 
 Sorry, folks.
 Could you come back tomorrow, too?

records.Japanese:
いやあ、すまなかったね
君たちも商売をしに来たんだろう？
records.current_English:
Sorry about that.
 You came to trade, right?

records.Japanese:
あの、なんで店主が病気だと
分かったんですか？
records.current_English: How did you know the owner was sick?

records.Japanese: そりゃ、顔色が悪かったからさ
records.current_English: He looked pale, that's all.

records.Japanese:
ほう、俺に負けず劣らず
なかなか洞察力がありそうだな
records.current_English:
Well, well. You're almost
 as sharp-eyed as I am.

records.Japanese: ……（そうだったかな？）
records.current_English: ...(Is he really that observant?)

records.Japanese:
まあ、普通じゃ気付かないだろうな
わたしはひとの健康状態にはちょっと
敏感でね
records.current_English:
Most people wouldn't notice. 
 I tend to notice when someone
 isn't feeling well.

records.Japanese: へえ…
records.current_English: Oh...

records.Japanese:
あんた…明日の朝
わたしと一緒に交易所に来るかい？
今日の埋め合わせはしてあげられると
思うんだが
records.current_English:
Would you come to the trade house
 with me tomorrow morning? I think
 I can make up for today.

records.Japanese: ありがとう。行きます
records.current_English: Thanks. We will.

records.Japanese: ああカルロ、昨日はありがとうよ！
records.current_English: Carlo! Thanks for yesterday!

records.Japanese: アディールはどうした？
records.current_English: How is Adil?

records.Japanese:
今日は家で寝てるよ
大事をとってね
records.current_English:
He's in bed at home today. 
 Just to be on the safe side.

records.Japanese: そうかい。早く治るといいな
records.current_English: I see. I hope he gets well soon.

records.Japanese:
あの人ったら、あたしの言うことなんか
聞きやしないんだよ。昨日だってさ
あんたが言ってくれなかったら…
records.current_English:
That man never listens 
 to a word I say. If you
 hadn't spoken up yesterday...

records.Japanese:
おっと、長話をしちまったね
あんたは命の恩人だ
お礼をしようと思ってね
records.current_English:
There I go, talking your ear off.
 You saved his life. I wanted 
 to do something to thank you.

records.Japanese:
ありがとよ。うれしいが
礼ならこっちの旅の人にしてくれ
商売を一晩待ってもらったんだ
records.current_English:
That's kind of you.          
 But thank these travelers. 
 They agreed to wait
 until morning to trade.

records.Japanese:
おやおや、そりゃ足止めしちゃって
悪かったねえ。たいしたものじゃないが
これ…。もらってくれるかい？
records.current_English:
Oh dear, we held you up. I'm sorry.
 It's nothing much, but...
 would you take this?

records.Japanese:
ありがとよ、おかみさん
旅の人、あんたたちは急ぐんだろ？
先に買い物をするといい
records.current_English:
Thank you, ma'am.
 You're in a hurry, aren't you? 
 Go ahead and do your trading first.

records.Japanese:
よう、カルロ！
昨日はすまなかったね！
records.current_English: Carlo! Sorry about yesterday!

records.Japanese: あんた！
records.current_English: You!

records.Japanese:
アディール！
寝てないとダメじゃないか！
records.current_English: Adil! You should be in bed!

records.Japanese:
ふん、おれはこの通りぴんぴん
してるよ。こんな商売日和にもたもた
寝てられるか！
records.current_English:
Hmph. Look at me. I'm fit as ever. 
 How can I lie around in bed on 
 a day this good for business?

records.Japanese: まったく、どうしようもない人だね！
records.current_English: Honestly, you're impossible!

records.Japanese:
ははは、それだけ元気なら安心だが
今日のところはあまり無理しちゃ
いけない
records.current_English:
Ha ha. If you've got that much 
 energy, I suppose
 I can stop worrying. 
 Just don't overdo it today.

records.Japanese:
私のほうはまた明日にでも顔を出す
から、この人たちの商いを頼むよ
records.current_English:
I'll stop by again, maybe tomorrow.
 For now, take care 
 of these travelers, will you?

records.Japanese:
旅の人。家族と健康を大切に
するんだよ。それじゃあな
records.current_English:
Look after your families 
 and take care of yourselves. 
 See you around.

records.Japanese: あの…
records.current_English: Um...

records.Japanese: ん？
records.current_English: Hm?

records.Japanese: …僕の船に乗ってくれませんか？
records.current_English: ...Would you like to sail with me?

records.Japanese: 何だい、急に
records.current_English: Where did that come from?

records.Japanese: あなたの商才と人柄には感服しました
records.current_English:
I admire your knack for trade, 
 and how you look out for people.

records.Japanese:
確かに、昨日の値切り方は
うまかったよなあ
records.current_English: He drove a hard bargain yesterday.

records.Japanese: まあ長年、商人をやってきたからね
records.current_English:
Well, I've been a merchant 
 a long time.

records.Japanese:
商人！
じゃ、相場に詳しいんですね？
records.current_English:
A merchant! Then you know all about
 market prices?

records.Japanese: やっぱ、プロだったか
records.current_English: I knew you were a pro.

records.Japanese: さすがじゃのう
records.current_English: That's impressive.

records.Japanese:
なあ、おやじさん。船に乗るのは
イヤかい？　家族が反対するとか？
records.current_English:
You don't want to go to sea? Think 
 your family would object?

records.Japanese:
家族は……いない
１年前に、死んでしまった
records.current_English:
My family... 
 I don't have one anymore. They died
 a year ago.

records.Japanese:
最初、娘が、はやり病にかかって
しまった。そのころのわたしは仕事に
夢中で…ちゃんと面倒を見て
やらなかったんだ
records.current_English:
My daughter came down
 with the sickness first. I was so
 wrapped up in work back then...
 I didn't take proper care of her.

records.Japanese:
結局、処置が遅れて妻にも
感染（うつ）って…
２人とも失ってしまった
records.current_English:
Treatment came too late. 
 My wife caught it, too...
 I lost them both.

records.Japanese: おじさん…
records.current_English: Carlo...

records.Japanese:
……家族を放り出してまで手に入れた
仕事はむなしいものだったよ
それ以来、わたしには仕事よりも
みんなの健康が気にかかるのさ
records.current_English:
...The work I'd put ahead
 of my family felt empty after that.
 Ever since, I've cared more about
 people's health than business.

records.Japanese: あ……だから、あの店の人のことも…
records.current_English:
Oh... So that's why you helped 
 the shopkeeper...

records.Japanese: …故郷には戻らないんですか？
records.current_English: ...Won't you return home?

records.Japanese:
ヴェネツィアかい？
あそこには楽しい思い出がたくさん
ありすぎる。１人では暮らせないよ
records.current_English:
To Venice? I have too many 
 happy memories there. I couldn't 
 live there alone.

records.Japanese:
おじさん……
やっぱり一緒に来てください
僕にはおじさんが必要です
records.current_English:
Carlo... Please come with us.
 I need you.

records.Japanese: うーん…
records.current_English: Hmm...

records.Japanese:
ねえ、クラウ
僕、この人から教わることは
たくさんあると思う
records.current_English:
Clau, I think I could learn a lot
 from him.

records.Japanese: …そうかもしれないな
records.current_English: ...Maybe so.

records.Japanese:
のう、艦長さんよ
みんなでこの人の新しい家族になると
いうのは、どうかね？
records.current_English:
Captain, what if all of us became
 his new family?

records.Japanese:
うん、それがいい！
おじさん…、どうでしょう？
records.current_English: That's it! Carlo... What do you say?

records.Japanese:
…ありがとう、みんな
そこまで言ってもらえるとは
records.current_English:
...Thank you, all of you. I never
 expected an offer like that.

records.Japanese:
じゃ、決まりだな
おっと、プロの商人としての腕前も
期待してるぜ
records.current_English:
Then it's settled. Oh, 
 and we're counting on
 those trading skills of yours, too.

records.Japanese:
わたしの名は、カルロ・シナートだ
よろしく
records.current_English:
My name is Carlo Sinat.
 Glad to be sailing with you.

groups.context: An expedition needs a purchase from the original town facility. Keep the directions and the rest of the exchange intact.

records.Japanese: これは…
records.current_English: This...

records.Japanese:
落石でもあったのでしょうか
これではとても通れません
records.current_English:
Could've been a rockfall.
 There's no way through like this.

records.Japanese: やむをえん。引き返すか
records.current_English: I suppose we'll have to turn back.

records.Japanese:
どうした？
戻るぞ、シャルル
records.current_English:
What's wrong?
 We're heading back, Charles.

records.Japanese: 爆破しましょう！
records.current_English: Let's blast it!

records.Japanese:
！？
爆破だと？
records.current_English: ?! Blow it up?

records.Japanese:
ええ、道をふさいでいる岩ごと
吹き飛ばすんです！
records.current_English:
Yes! We'll blast away the rocks
 blocking the path!

records.Japanese:
本気か？
こんなに固い岩石を吹き飛ばすには
相当量の火薬が必要だぞ
records.current_English:
Are you serious? It would take 
 a great deal of gunpowder to blast 
 through rock this hard.

records.Japanese:
それだけまとまった量の火薬を
一度に入手するのはまず不可能だろう
records.current_English:
Getting so much gunpowder at once
 is nearly impossible.

records.Japanese:
ご心配なく。火薬なんて
我々の手で作ればいいのです
records.current_English:
Don't worry. We can make 
 the gunpowder ourselves.

records.Japanese:
火薬を？
作れるのか？
records.current_English: You can make it?

records.Japanese:
提督…私の研究を忘れたんですか？
硫黄を大量に入手してもらえれば
いつでも作りますよ
records.current_English:
Admiral... Have you forgotten
 my research? Bring me
 plenty of sulfur, and I'll make it 
 whenever you need it.

records.Japanese:
硫黄なら、この街にも
売っていたと思いますが
records.current_English: I think they sell sulfur in town.

records.Japanese:
ええ、交易所で買って
ここに運ぶんです
records.current_English:
Yes. Buy it at the trade house 
 and bring it here.

records.Japanese: よし、硫黄を仕入れてこよう
records.current_English: Good. We'll buy sulfur.

groups.context: Carlo follows up on a delayed deal. Review the invitation and what he tentatively offers against the rest of the exchange.

records.Japanese: シナモンをいつもの量で、頼むよ
records.current_English: My usual order of cinnamon, please.

records.Japanese: （先客？）
records.current_English: (Someone's already here?)

records.Japanese: はいよ、お代はこれだけだ
records.current_English: You got it. Here's the price.

records.Japanese: おや、値上がりしたんだね
records.current_English: Oh? Price went up?

records.Japanese:
そんなことないよ
いつもこんなもんじゃないか
records.current_English: No. Same as always.

records.Japanese:
ははは、アディール。バカ言っちゃ
いけない。あんたがいくらで仕入れて
いるか、わたしが知らないとでも
思っているのかい？
records.current_English:
Ha ha! Don't be silly, Adil. 
 You think I don't know what
 you paid for it?

records.Japanese: おいおい
records.current_English: Hey...

records.Japanese:
今年の出来高とこのへんの需要を
考えれば、もう少し何とかできると
思うんだけどねえ
records.current_English:
Given this year's crop and local 
 demand, you can do better.

records.Japanese:
なんなら、他をあたってもいいさ
いつも同じ店から仕入れなきゃ
ならないって法もないし
records.current_English:
I could always try somewhere else. 
 There's no law saying I have to buy
 from the same shop every time.

records.Japanese:
うっ
…わ、分かったよ
もう、あんたにはかなわねえな
records.current_English:
Ugh... All right, all right. 
 I can't win with you.

records.Japanese:
ん？
…アディール、熱でもあるのかい？
records.current_English: Hm? Adil, do you have a fever?

records.Japanese:
何だよ、カルロ。まだ俺の商売に
難クセつけようってのかい？
records.current_English:
What now, Carlo? Still finding 
 fault with the way I do business?

records.Japanese:
そうじゃない。おまえさん
熱があるよ。今日は早く寝るんだね
records.current_English:
That's not what I mean. You've got 
 a fever. Get to bed early tonight.

records.Japanese:
またまた、何を……
あれ？　何だか本当に寒気がする
records.current_English:
Oh, stop... Huh? I really am 
 getting the chills.

records.Japanese:
ほらごらん。買い物は明日にするから
今日は店じまいだ
records.current_English:
You see? I'll do my shopping 
 tomorrow. Close up for the day.

records.Japanese:
うーん…、あんたの言うとおりに
しよう。そこの人も
悪いけど明日にしておくれ
records.current_English:
Hmm... I'll take your advice.
 Sorry, you folks over there. You'll
 have to come back tomorrow, too.

records.Japanese:
いやあ、すまなかったね
君たちも商売をしに来たんだろう？
records.current_English:
Sorry about that. You came 
 to trade, right?

records.Japanese: なぜ、病気だと？
records.current_English: How'd you know?

records.Japanese: そりゃ、顔色が悪かったからさ
records.current_English: His complexion.

records.Japanese:
ほう、俺に負けず劣らず
なかなか洞察力がありそうだな
records.current_English: Sharp eyes. I'd say he's my equal.

records.Japanese:
そうかしら…？
悪いというほどではなかったと
思うけれど…
records.current_English:
Really...? He didn't look
 that bad to me...

records.Japanese:
まあ、普通じゃ気付かないだろうな
わたしはひとの健康状態にはちょっと
敏感でね
records.current_English:
Most people wouldn't notice. 
 I'm rather sensitive 
 to people's health.
(Oh my...)

records.Japanese:
あんた…明日の朝
わたしと一緒に交易所に来るかい？
今日の埋め合わせはしてあげられると
思うんだが
records.current_English:
Will you come to the trade house 
 with me tomorrow morning?
 I think I can make up for today.

records.Japanese: ええ、行きましょう
records.current_English: Yes, let's do that.

records.Japanese: ああカルロ、昨日はありがとうよ！
records.current_English: Carlo! Thanks for yesterday!

records.Japanese: アディールはどうした？
records.current_English: How is Adil?

records.Japanese:
今日は家で寝てるよ
大事をとってね
records.current_English: Resting at home. Just in case.

records.Japanese: そうかい。早く治るといいな
records.current_English: I see. I hope he's better soon.

records.Japanese:
あの人ったら、あたしの言うことなんか
聞きやしないんだよ。昨日だってさ
あんたが言ってくれなかったら…
records.current_English:
That man never listens to a word 
 I say. If you hadn't spoken
 to him yesterday...

records.Japanese:
おっと、長話をしちまったね
あんたは命の恩人だ
お礼をしようと思ってね
records.current_English:
Listen to me go on.
 You saved his life.
 I wanted to thank you.

records.Japanese:
ありがとよ。うれしいが
礼ならこっちの旅の人にしてくれ
商売を一晩待ってもらったんだ
records.current_English:
Thank you. I appreciate
 it, but thank these travelers
 instead. They had to put off 
 their business overnight.

records.Japanese:
おやおや、そりゃ足止めしちゃって
悪かったねえ。たいしたものじゃないが
これ…。もらってくれるかい？
records.current_English:
Oh my, sorry to delay you. 
 Not much, but please take this.

records.Japanese:
ありがとよ、おかみさん
旅の人、あんたたちは急ぐんだろ？
先に買い物をするといい
records.current_English:
Thank you, ma'am. You folks
 are in a hurry, aren't you? Go 
 ahead and do your shopping first.

records.Japanese:
よう、カルロ！
昨日はすまなかったね！
records.current_English: Carlo! Sorry about yesterday!

records.Japanese: あんた！
records.current_English: You!

records.Japanese:
アディール！
寝てないとダメじゃないか！
records.current_English: Adil! You should be in bed!

records.Japanese:
ふん、おれはこの通りぴんぴん
してるよ。こんな商売日和にもたもた
寝てられるか！
records.current_English:
Hmph! I'm as fit as ever. On 
 a fine day for business like 
 this, you won't catch me lazing
 around in bed!

records.Japanese: まったく、どうしようもない人だね！
records.current_English: You're impossible!

records.Japanese:
ははは、それだけ元気なら安心だが
今日のところはあまり無理しちゃ
いけない
records.current_English:
Ha ha! I'm glad you've got 
 your energy back, but don't overdo 
 it today.

records.Japanese:
私のほうはまた明日にでも顔を出す
から、この人たちの商いを頼むよ
records.current_English:
I'll stop by another day. Take care
 of these folks for me.

records.Japanese:
旅の人。家族と健康を大切に
するんだよ。それじゃあな
records.current_English:
Take good care of your family
 and your health. I'll
 be seeing you.

records.Japanese: …待って
records.current_English: ...Wait.

records.Japanese: ん？
records.current_English: Hm?

records.Japanese:
カルロさんでしたね…
あなたの商才、わたしの船で
活かしてもらえないかしら？
records.current_English:
Carlo, was it? Would you put 
 your trading skill to use
 aboard my ship?

records.Japanese: おいおい、突然何を言い出すんだい
records.current_English: What? That's rather sudden.

records.Japanese:
突然じゃないわ
昨日から考えていたの
records.current_English:
It isn't sudden. I've been thinking
 about it since yesterday.

records.Japanese:
わたしは船乗りじゃない
ただの商人だよ
records.current_English: I'm no sailor. I'm just a merchant.

records.Japanese:
では、相場には詳しいでしょう？
艦隊には、商人の才覚がある人も
必要なのよ
records.current_English:
Then you know the markets, 
 don't you? A fleet needs people
 with a head for business, too.

records.Japanese:
１人で船に乗るのがイヤなのかしら？
家族と離れたくないとか？
records.current_English:
Do you dislike sailing alone?
 Or leaving your family?

records.Japanese:
家族は……いない
１年前に、死んでしまった
records.current_English:
My family... They're gone. 
 They died a year ago.

records.Japanese:
最初、娘が、はやり病にかかって
しまった。そのころのわたしは仕事に
夢中で…ちゃんと面倒を見て
やらなかったんだ
records.current_English:
First my daughter caught an illness
 that was going around. 
 I was so absorbed in my work...
 I didn't take proper care of her.

records.Japanese:
結局、処置が遅れて妻にも
感染（うつ）って…
２人とも失ってしまった
records.current_English:
I didn't act in time, and my wife
 caught it, too... I lost them both.

records.Japanese: そんなことが…
records.current_English: How awful...

records.Japanese:
……家族を放り出してまで手に入れた
仕事はむなしいものだったよ
それ以来、わたしには仕事よりも
みんなの健康が気にかかるのさ
records.current_English:
The work I'd neglected my family 
 for felt empty after that... 
 Ever since, I've cared more about
 people's health than business.

records.Japanese: あ……だから、あの店の人のことも…
records.current_English:
Oh... So that's why you were 
 worried about the shopkeeper...

records.Japanese: …それで、故郷には？
records.current_English: ...What about going home?

records.Japanese:
ヴェネツィアかい？
あそこには楽しい思い出がたくさん
ありすぎる。１人では暮らせないよ
records.current_English:
Venice? Too many happy memories
 there. Can't live there alone.

records.Japanese:
ヴェネツィアに１人で帰るのが
イヤなら、私たちと一緒に行けば
いいわ
records.current_English:
If you don't want to go
 back to Venice alone, come with us.

records.Japanese:
船で行動を共にすれば、みんな家族も
同然だわ。新しい家族も悪くないと
思うけど
records.current_English:
When you share a life aboard 
 a ship, you're practically family. 
 A new family might not be such 
 a bad thing.

records.Japanese:
あんたたち……
わたしの新しい家族になってくれると
言うのか？
records.current_English: You... would become my new family?

records.Japanese: あなたが、イヤでなければ
records.current_English: If you'd like us to be.

records.Japanese:
……ありがとう。喜んで船に
乗せてもらうよ
records.current_English: ...Thank you. Gladly.

records.Japanese:
わたしの名は、カルロ・シナートだ
よろしく
records.current_English:
I'm Carlo Sinat. I'm glad
 to be joining you.
